content.title: Begin checkout from the cart
content.description: A shopper with a non-empty basket enters checkout from the cart, sees the available entry paths for an anonymous session, verifies that the checkout summary matches the cart totals, and can leave and return without losing basket contents.
content.value: Keeps the purchase journey reachable and intact at the point where revenue conversion begins.
criteria: From a non-empty cart, checkout entry is visible and clickable.
An anonymous shopper is offered guest checkout and register/login options at checkout.
The checkout order summary matches the cart totals exactly.
Leaving checkout and returning preserves basket contents.
